title: calceolaria rugosa var. glandulifera
intro: Calceolaria rugosa var. glandulifera, commonly known as the "Pocket Flower", is a flowering plant species native to South America. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calceolaria rugosa var. glandulifera include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been identified to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
